# Source: nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max: # Adapted for wisp-design: schema condensed to 6 columns; web stacks only.

column3: tabular-nums everywhere
column4: semantic up/down colour
column5: single-pixel rules.

column3: prompt
column4: css_template
column5: checklist

column3: Page ground — true dark, financial-terminal feel
column4: background: var(--dd-ground); color: var(--dd-fg); font-family: var(--dd-mono);
column5: ☐ ground L≥0.10 (not pure black) ☐ AA contrast body ☐ mono throughout for tabular alignment

column3: Tick table — dense rows, single-pixel rules, tabular-nums, semantic up/down
column4: width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-family: var(--dd-mono); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.4;
column5: ☐ tabular-nums ☐ row-height ≤24px ☐ hairline rules ☐ no zebra ☐ AA contrast all cells

column3: Single tick row — minimum height, no padding waste
column4: display: grid; grid-template-columns: 8ch 12ch 10ch 10ch 8ch; gap: 4px; padding: 2px 6px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--dd-rule); align-items: center;
column5: ☐ ch-based columns ☐ vertical padding ≤4px ☐ tabular-nums ☐ AA contrast

column3: Positive delta — semantic green, mono
column4: color: var(--dd-up); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-weight: 500;
column5: ☐ AA contrast on ground ☐ semantic colour + arrow glyph (not colour alone) ☐ tabular-nums

column3: Negative delta — semantic red, mono
column4: color: var(--dd-down); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-weight: 500;
column5: ☐ AA contrast on ground ☐ semantic colour + arrow glyph (not colour alone) ☐ tabular-nums

column3: Flat delta — muted neutral
column4: color: var(--dd-fg-muted); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
column5: ☐ AA contrast ☐ neutral colour (not absent) ☐ tabular-nums

column3: Numeric cell — right-aligned, tabular-nums
column4: text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; padding-inline: 6px;
column5: ☐ right-aligned for digit alignment ☐ tabular-nums ☐ AA contrast

column3: Label cell — left-aligned, uppercase ticker
column4: text-align: left; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.02em; padding-inline: 6px;
column5: ☐ semantic colour + text (ticker conveys identity) ☐ AA contrast ☐ uppercase

column3: Header row — sticky, small caps, hairline rule below
column4: position: sticky; top: 0; background: var(--dd-ground); color: var(--dd-fg-muted); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; padding: 4px 6px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--dd-fg-muted);
column5: ☐ semantic <th scope='col'> ☐ sticky on scroll ☐ AA contrast

column3: Top nav — single-row dense, mono, hairline rule
column4: display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; padding: 6px 12px; background: var(--dd-ground); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--dd-rule); font-family: var(--dd-mono); font-size: 12px; height: 32px;
column5: ☐ semantic <nav> ☐ skip-link ☐ dense height (≤32px) ☐ AA contrast

column3: Inline status pill — semantic colour, dense, mono
column4: display: inline-flex; padding: 1px 5px; background: transparent; color: var(--dd-up); border: 1px solid var(--dd-up); border-radius: 2px; font-family: var(--dd-mono); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600;
column5: ☐ semantic colour + text (not colour alone) ☐ AA contrast ☐ no pill rounding (square corners)

column3: Inline sparkline — minimal, semantic colour, no axis
column4: width: 60px; height: 16px; display: inline-block; vertical-align: middle; color: var(--dd-up);
column5: ☐ aria-label describes trend ☐ AA contrast ☐ no axis labels (inline)

column3: Dense input — single-line, mono, hairline border
column4: padding: 2px 6px; background: var(--dd-ground); color: var(--dd-fg); font-family: var(--dd-mono); font-size: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--dd-rule); border-radius: 2px; height: 22px;
column5: ☐ font-size could be 12 (mono allows) but 14px+ preferred for body ☐ focus shifts border to fg ☐ AA contrast ☐ visible label

column3: Toolbar — single-line, dense, mono buttons
column4: display: flex; gap: 4px; padding: 4px 8px; background: var(--dd-surface-1); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--dd-rule); height: 28px; align-items: center;
column5: ☐ dense height (≤28px) ☐ AA contrast ☐ keyboard-nav across buttons

column3: Keyboard shortcut hint — mono, bracketed
column4: display: inline-flex; padding: 1px 4px; background: transparent; color: var(--dd-fg-muted); border: 1px solid var(--dd-rule); border-radius: 2px; font-family: var(--dd-mono); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600;
column5: ☐ semantic <kbd> ☐ AA contrast ☐ bracketed feel via border

column3: Panel divider — single-pixel rule between columns
column4: width: 1px; background: var(--dd-rule);
column5: ☐ no double-pixel ☐ visible enough on dark ground ☐ aria-hidden

column3: Chart axis label — small mono, muted
column4: font-family: var(--dd-mono); font-size: 10px; color: var(--dd-fg-muted); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
column5: ☐ AA contrast ☐ tabular-nums ☐ semantic colour + text on chart

column3: Selected row — accent ground, AA inverted
column4: background: var(--dd-accent-soft); color: var(--dd-fg);
column5: ☐ AA contrast on accent-soft ☐ aria-selected ☐ keyboard reachable

column3: Dense focus ring — single-pixel accent outline
column4: outline: 1px solid var(--dd-accent); outline-offset: 0;
column5: ☐ visible on all interactive ☐ AA contrast ☐ no offset (dense layout)

column3: Context menu — dense rows, mono, hairline rules
column4: padding: 4px 0; background: var(--dd-surface-1); border: 1px solid var(--dd-rule); border-radius: 2px; font-family: var(--dd-mono); font-size: 12px; min-width: 180px;
column5: ☐ aria-menu role ☐ keyboard-nav ☐ ESC closes ☐ AA contrast

column3: Context menu row — dense, single-line
column4: padding: 3px 12px; line-height: 1.4; cursor: pointer;
column5: ☐ AA contrast ☐ hover state ground-shift ☐ dense (line-height 1.4)
